diving.alt: School of deep blue redtooth triggerfish swimming in open water.
diving.title: Vampire of the Blue: Redtooth Triggerfish
diving.caption: Despite their menacing crimson fangs and gothic blue silhouettes, Redtooth Triggerfish (Odonus niger) are mostly peaceful plankton nibblers who just happen to look like tiny underwater draculas out for a Sunday group stroll.

diving.alt: Whitetip reef shark patrolling peacefully over shallow coral.
diving.title: The Neighborhood Patrol: Whitetip Reef Shark
diving.caption: Cruising low like a reef stealth bomber, the Whitetip Reef Shark (Triaenodon obesus) is the calmest resident on the block—at least until nightfall, when it squeezes into tight coral crevices like an oceanic cat burglar.

diving.alt: Long-spined sea urchin with iridescent blue glowing rings among reef rocks.
diving.title: Nature's Disco Pincushion: Long-Spined Sea Urchin
diving.caption: Do not hug the sea urchin (Diadema setosum), no matter how tempting that glowing iridescent blue neon ring and disco-ball aesthetic looks! An essential reef lawnmower with zero chill regarding personal space.

diving.alt: Tomato clownfish peeking out from pink-tipped sea anemone tentacles.
diving.title: Feisty Penthouse Owner: Tomato Clownfish
diving.caption: A Tomato Clownfish (Amphiprion frenatus) nestled snugly inside its bubble-tip anemone penthouse. Total immunity to stinging tentacles means this fiery little homeowner will bravely charge a human diver twenty times its size to defend its living couch.

diving.alt: Lian scuba diving in clear blue water, swimming gracefully in neutral buoyancy.
diving.title: Homo sapiens aquaticus: Lian in Her Element
diving.caption: Lian demonstrating neutral buoyancy and peak zen mode. Symptoms include steady bubbles, zero-gravity hair drift, and an irresistible urge to spend entire afternoons staring at sea cucumbers.

diving.alt: Whitetip reef shark cruising over a sandy seabed surrounded by a school of fusiliers.
diving.title: Parting the Crowds: Whitetip & Fusiliers
diving.caption: When you walk into a room with confidence and a dorsal fin. The shimmering school of fusiliers maintains a polite three-foot radius of pure biological respect.

diving.alt: Green sea turtle swimming forward in open water with a remora hitching a ride on its shell.
diving.title: The Ocean's Free Ride: Green Sea Turtle & Remora
diving.caption: The reef's five-star rideshare service. The Green Sea Turtle (Chelonia mydas) provides smooth luxury transit, while the Remora hitchhiker (Echeneis naucrates) offers zero tip and free shell-cleaning services.

diving.alt: Long, slender cornetfish flutemouth hovering camouflaged over coral.
diving.title: Living Chopstick: Smooth Flutemouth Cornetfish
diving.caption: Meet Fistularia commersonii, the world's most aerodynamic underwater noodle. It hovers motionless above the reef, pretending to be harmless driftwood before vacuuming unsuspecting small fry into that ridiculous straw snout.

diving.alt: Whitecheek surgeonfish with vivid black and yellow markings grazing near corals.
diving.title: Velvet Tuxedo: Whitecheek Surgeonfish
diving.caption: Dressed to the nines in matte black and electric yellow trims. The Whitecheek Surgeonfish (Acanthurus nigricans) grazes on algae with aristocratic poise, equipped with hidden scalpels at the base of its tail just in case anyone gets pushy.

diving.alt: Large starry pufferfish hovering over white sand alongside yellow goatfish.
diving.title: The Hovering Blimp: Starry Pufferfish
diving.caption: The giant Starry Pufferfish (Arothron stellatus) drifts along like a spotted underwater dirigible. Equipped with beak-like dental plates capable of crushing clamshells, yet perpetually looking like it forgot where it parked its car.

diving.alt: White-spotted pufferfish looking curiously toward the camera with big round eyes.
diving.title: Deep Sea Puppy Eyes: White-Spotted Puffer
diving.caption: How can something full of deadly tetrodotoxin look this utterly adorable? Arothron hispidus peering out with curious, soulful eyes from between coral blocks. Please resist the urge to boop the snoot.

diving.alt: Lian freediving downwards into deep blue ocean water with long freediving fins.
diving.title: One Breath Journey: Lian Freediving the Abyss
diving.caption: Lian gliding into the serene blue on a single breath of air. Advanced freediving is pure meditation in motion: heart rate slows, worldly distractions vanish, and you become completely weightless between sea and sky.

diving.alt: Green sea turtle viewed from above gliding serenely over a coral reef.
diving.title: Gliding on Liquid Wings: Green Sea Turtle
diving.caption: Flying without an airplane. A Green Sea Turtle (Chelonia mydas) cruising effortlessly over the reef crest with ancient grace, reminding every clumsy human swimmer how hydrodynamics was actually meant to look.

diving.alt: Whitetip reef shark banking sharply during an underwater turn near the reef.
diving.title: Sleek Cornering: Whitetip on the Turn
diving.caption: Perfect turn radius without ever touching the brakes. A Whitetip Reef Shark (Triaenodon obesus) making a smooth arc along the reef, showcasing millions of years of hydrodynamic perfection.

diving.alt: Moorish idol showing its striking black, white, and yellow stripes and long dorsal banner.
diving.title: The Haute Couture Icon: Moorish Idol
diving.caption: The unmistakable Zanclus cornutus, rocking its dramatic trailing dorsal pennant like a supermodel on a runway. The sole surviving member of its prehistoric fish family, and it definitely knows it.

diving.alt: Raccoon butterflyfish with black eye mask and bright yellow markings swimming near corals.
diving.title: Reef Bandit: Raccoon Butterflyfish
diving.caption: Caught red-handed—or rather yellow-finned! Chaetodon lunula wears a classic black bandit mask while sneaking around coral heads after dark in search of sea anemone snacks and tasty nudibranchs.

diving.alt: Green sea turtle resting peacefully on the sandy ocean floor with chin on sand.
diving.title: Midday Power Nap: Resting Green Sea Turtle
diving.caption: Chin parked directly in the soft sand, flippers tucked in, completely unbothered by worldly drama. We could all take notes from this Chelonia mydas on the fine art of the unapologetic power nap.

diving.alt: Whitetip reef shark patrolling alongside a dramatic coral reef drop-off wall.
diving.title: Patrolling the Drop-Off: Reef Shark on the Edge
diving.caption: Gliding along the edge of the blue wall where the coral shelf plunges into the abyss. Whitetip reef sharks love these current-swept drop-offs where hunting meets effortless soaring.

diving.alt: Picasso triggerfish displaying intricate blue, black, and orange geometric patterns.
diving.title: Cubist Masterpiece: Picasso Triggerfish
diving.caption: Known in Hawaii as Humuhumunukunukuāpuaʻa. Rhinecanthus aculeatus looks like Pablo Picasso designed a fish during his most inspired geometric phase. Highly territorial; will fiercely chase diver fins that dare cross its invisible lawn!

diving.alt: Undulated moray eel swimming across the reef with its mouth open showing needle teeth.
diving.title: When the Moon Hits Your Eye: Undulated Moray
diving.caption: That's a moray! Gymnothorax undulatus isn't actually roaring or menacing you; eels must constantly open and close their mouths to pump oxygen across their gills. Still, that hidden second set of pharyngeal jaws is straight out of the movie Alien.

diving.alt: Tawny nurse shark swimming slowly over reef with an entourage of schooling fish.
diving.title: The Don of the Reef: Nurse Shark & Entourage
diving.caption: A Tawny Nurse Shark (Nebrius ferrugineus) making its grand entrance, complete with an intimidating squad of personal jack fish bodyguards. A nocturnal suction-feeder that can slurp up prey with the force of an industrial vacuum cleaner.

diving.alt: Vibrant blue tang palette surgeonfish hovering brightly above reef substrate.
diving.title: "Just Keep Swimming": Blue Palette Surgeonfish
diving.caption: The real-life Dory! Paracanthurus hepatus sporting that dazzling electric-blue and taxi-cab-yellow livery. When spooked, young blue tangs will literally wedge themselves between coral branches and play dead until danger passes.

diving.alt: Large school of black durgon triggerfish with white fin lines swimming in open water.
diving.title: Synchronized Swimmers: Schooling Black Durgons
diving.caption: Melichthys niger schooling by the dozens in midwater. Look closely at the bases of their dorsal and anal fins—those glowing white bioluminescent-looking pinstripes illuminate like tiny neon runways as they flutter in sync.

diving.alt: Whitetip reef shark casting a shadow as it glides over white coral sand.
diving.title: White Sand Runway: Whitetip Reef Shark
diving.caption: Cruising low across a sugar-white coral sand channel. Unlike many open-water sharks that must swim constantly to breathe, Whitetip Reef Sharks have buccal pumps, letting them lounge happily on the sea floor whenever they feel lazy.

diving.alt: Green sea turtle viewed from behind as it swims smoothly into the turquoise distance.
diving.title: Flipper Waves: Sea Turtle Heading to the Blue
diving.caption: "Catch ya later, humans!" A gentle Green Sea Turtle (Chelonia mydas) paddling effortlessly toward the outer reef flats, leaving nothing behind but calm ripples and diver envy.

diving.alt: Bright orange clownfish peeking out from dense anemone tentacles.
diving.title: Snug as a Bug: Clownfish in Its Anemone
diving.caption: We found Nemo! Amphiprion ocellaris happily burrowing into the stinging tentacles of its host anemone. The fish coats itself in special mucus that mimics the anemone's own chemical signature, rendering it completely invisible to the stinging nematocysts.

diving.alt: Guineafowl puffer covered in white polka dots hovering near lobe coral.
diving.title: Polka-Dot Rocket: Guineafowl Puffer
diving.caption: Sporting the finest polka dots in the Pacific! Arothron meleagris in its starry dark morph. Slow, chunky, and propelled by fluttering dorsal fins like an underwater bumblebee, it uses its parrot-like beak to crunch down whole coral tips for breakfast.

diving.alt: Swarm of vibrant orange and red lyretail anthias fluttering above a coral bommie.
diving.title: Coral Reef Fireworks: Sea Goldies & Anthias
diving.caption: An underwater confetti explosion! These vibrant peach-and-ruby Pseudanthias squamipinnis dance in the current just above the coral pinnacle, ready to vanish into the coral labyrinth at the first sign of a passing predator.

diving.alt: Dense swirling school of silver bigeye trevally packing the frame underwater.
diving.title: The Silver Tornado: Bigeye Trevally School
diving.caption: Stepping inside a living, swirling vortex of silver mirrors. Bigeye Trevallies (Caranx sexfasciatus) form these massive glittering cylindrical schools to confuse predators and slice through heavy ocean currents with maximum hydrodynamic teamwork.

diving.alt: Vibrant flock of bright yellow tangs grazing across a sunlit coral reef.
diving.title: A Burst of Sunshine: Yellow Tangs
diving.caption: Like someone spilled a bag of underwater lemon drops across the reef! These sun-drenched Zebrasoma flavescens serve as the reef's premier algae janitors, keeping corals spotless while glowing like neon beacons under the tropical sun.

snowboarding.title: Bluebird Powder Day
snowboarding.alt: Panoramic view of snow-covered mountain ridges and pine trees under a bright blue sky.
snowboarding.caption: Crisp mountain air, endless white peaks, and fresh tracks waiting through the evergreen glades.

snowboarding.title: Summit Sunbeam
snowboarding.alt: Steep snowy alpine peak with a radiant beam of sunlight breaking over the ridge.
snowboarding.caption: Catching morning light above the tree line on the upper ridge. High altitude, clear skies, and pure quiet.

snowboarding.title: Winter Wonderland Glades
snowboarding.alt: Snowy ski slopes and snow-dusted evergreens under a soft winter sky.
snowboarding.caption: Moody winter skies and deep, soft powder between the snowy pines.

companions.title: Midnight Snack: Fluffy Hamster
companions.alt: Fluffy white dwarf hamster holding a snack with tiny paws.
companions.caption: Caught red-handed during an essential midnight snack break. Small in size, but holding down the fort with maximum cheek pouch capacity.

companions.title: Ready for Takeoff: Mochi's T-Pose
companions.alt: Lian holding up Mochi the fluffy Ragdoll cat with arms outstretched.
companions.caption: Cleared for departure on runway one! Mochi demonstrating peak aerodynamic fluff and supreme patience with human shenanigans.

companions.title: The Executive Chair: Boss Mochi
companions.alt: Mochi the cat lounging casually on a blue office desk chair with one leg raised.
companions.caption: Excuse me, was this your office chair? It's under new management now. Casual leg stretch included to demonstrate complete dominance.

companions.title: Posing for the Camera: Fluffy Mochi
companions.alt: Mochi the grey and white Ragdoll cat resting gracefully on the floor.
companions.caption: Looking regal and attentive. Half cat, half cloud, and 100% aware of how photogenic he is.

companions.title: The Low-Angle Judgment: Summer
companions.alt: Close-up selfie angle of Summer the black and white cat looking down.
companions.caption: When you accidentally open your front camera. Summer delivering a 10/10 unamused stare with majestic whiskers from high above.

companions.title: The Gym Routine: Hamster Workouts
companions.alt: White dwarf hamster standing up on hind legs nibbling a hanging wood block.
companions.caption: Balancing on tiptoes for the hanging snack block! Determination, balance, and pure fluff in one compact frame.

companions.title: Recharging Batteries: Sleeping Summer
companions.alt: Summer the black and white cat curled up sound asleep with paw tucked in.
companions.caption: Cookies-and-cream loaf mode engaged. Summer demonstrating proper laboratory work-life balance by sleeping 16 hours a day.

music.alt: Lian Wang playing pipa in a performance portrait.
music.title: Pipa Portrait
music.caption: Performance portrait of Lian playing pipa.
